name: sc.schedule

parameters.query:
SELECT j.id, extract(dow FROM j.slot_at AT TIME ZONE $1)::int AS dow, to_char(j.slot_at AT TIME ZONE $1, 'HH24:MI') AS time,
  m.views, m.likes, m.comments
FROM jobs j LEFT JOIN metrics m ON m.job_id = j.id AND m.age_h = 48
WHERE j.status IN ('live', 'done') AND j.slot_at > now() - interval '90 days';
SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(dow, to_char(publish_time, 'HH24:MI')), '{}') AS current FROM schedule;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [JSON.stringify($json.rows), $json.reason, JSON.stringify({ changed: $json.changed, changed_days: $json.changed_days, week: $json.week, confidence: $json.confidence, explore_day: $json.explore_day, reason: $json.reason, problems: $json.problems })] }}

description: Sunday 04:00: code builds per time × weekday stats from metrics; < 12 published → rotate candidates; else the Scheduler picks inside fixed rules, checked in code. An assigned slot never moves (PLAN §4.7, §10.6).
